purpose: Ten structurally inspected, real play-prod endpoint edit prompts for Metis Brain hard-path qualification.

census.selection_rule: Ranked from parsed declarations and observed constructs, then diversified across search, similarity, TVOD, 4K capability, personalized context, parameterized blocks, variants, output contracts, fallbacks and alternatives. Endpoint names alone were not used as complexity evidence.

tenant_snapshot.verification: Read-only HEAD/status/tree check before and after census; no tenant path is writable in this task.

grounding: Use the pinned schema-2 reviewed projection with catalog identity (catalog, field); draft, fuzzy, legacy-only or unreviewed literals are not grounding authority.
grounding.selections is the complete final finite-predicate set for the edited scope: reject stale predicates, omitted requested selections and duplicate selections.
Every changed finite value must be an exact reviewed value; structural/output edits do not authorize inventing a catalog value.
output: Preserve the exact existing take mode and cardinality unless the prompt explicitly changes the named occurrence; total results and page size are never conflated.
Preserve response shape, metadata template, ordering, deduplication, view-all and fallback semantics unless an explicitly named occurrence is changed.
Fallback is source behavior to preserve and inspect, not permission to invent a fallback or silently remove one.
compiler: Validate the candidate against the pinned Metis grammar/toolchain and the complete tenant snapshot before any proposal is considered successful.
Require first-attempt compile-clean evidence plus the semantic/output oracle; compile-clean text alone is insufficient.

The compiler-owned lossless bridge is admitted only for one exact IncludeClause whose existing finite-field roster equals the reviewed grounding roster; every more complex occurrence must decline to the full Model 1 path.
draft_only: Emit an inspectable Draft/proposal and exact changed spans only; never call Apply.
Require tenant_modified=false, unchanged tenant HEAD/tree/status and unchanged target source hash outside the declared edit spans.
Any unresolved scope, branch, count/page, fallback, or grounding ambiguity must yield a typed clarification or unsupported/fail-closed result.

universal_capabilities: Keep the conversation and Draft lineage server-owned; each turn carries only the new user decision and the delta from the prior Draft.
Ask only a typed clarification whose answer changes catalog, total-versus-page cardinality, response shape, fallback policy or a genuinely ambiguous parameter/branch.
After every accepted turn, preserve prior accepted choices and all non-target structure; never infer an omitted filter, fallback, branch or parameter.
Validate exact reviewed grounding, complete final finite-predicate selections, output contract and pinned compiler on every Draft; unresolved ambiguity fails closed.
Converge only when the final Draft has the requested structure, first-attempt compile-clean evidence, no duplicate/omitted selections, and Draft-only tenant invariance.
case_dependent_capabilities: Similarity endpoints require seed/candidate context, similarity promotion and branch-specific alternatives.
Search endpoints require query/channel inputs, variant routing, relevance/order rules and search-specific view-all/fallback behavior.
Homepage multi-block endpoints require named block reuse, instance arguments, row ordering and optional personalization.
TVOD/4K endpoints require parameter or capability guards and must distinguish shared block declarations from instance arguments.
Fallback, expanded response, nested pagination, `take * 2`, metadata templates and smart ordering are preserved only for cases that actually contain them.
global_convergence: Final proposal is semantically/structurally equivalent to the selected source feature roster, while allowing the explicitly requested business delta.
All requested clarifications are answered once; no repeated question/options and no more than three blocking questions.
Grounding, output, pinned compiler and Draft-only oracles are green; a private lossless render is allowed only in the admitted subset, while public tenant Apply remains disabled.
